purpose: Qualify same-artifact repeatability before enrolling ANY future candidate; cannot rescue or reinterpret C2-T@2.
baseline: ec72 qualified ff canonical artifact05b105b1; freeze exact source/artifact/13links/deps and actualNode24.19 before execution
population: Exact original enrollment636c39dc: ordered H27+D48 all75, unchanged workflow/options/full final SVG and receipt UTF8 consumption. No source-name filtering or omitted tails.

campaigns.engine: actual ELK from same accepted artifact

caches: NORMAL same originalcacheenvironment; does not assert hits

workerSchedule.order: Exact original all75 order on every pass; no adjacent per-input repeat specialization.
workerSchedule.warmupCallTiming: Record wall and processCPU descriptively on BOTH warmup passes without including them in measured aggregates.
workerSchedule.timedWindow: Fixed four complete passes,300 fully consumed API-call windows per worker. Their raw wall sums double the two-pass@2 aggregate; this is a longer aggregate observation, not a claim of one contiguous uninterrupted window. All per-call values retained.
workerSchedule.measurementBoundary: Same measuredCall invoke+SVGBuffer+full receipt stringify+UTF8buffer; hashing/payload/journal/progress I/O remain outside per-call windows. No profiler, forcedGC, adaptive time loop, early stability stop, candidate or runtime source hooks.
workerSchedule.record: All raw450calls+ordered journal, full output fingerprints/oracles, workerlaunch/reap chronology, actual import and total worker elapsed, environment/Node/artifact/dependency/fullsource bindings. Capture lightweight host/cgroup quota/throttle counters before/after outside measured windows if permitted; descriptive only.

operationalGuards.boundScope: Each engine is a separately predeclared baseline-only campaign with both cache policies. Each policy has6serialfreshworkers under a shared480s bound. Total planned24workers across both engines/policies. This is extra calibration, not an enlarged C2-T deadline.
operationalGuards.ledger: Allslots persisted before first launch; running persisted beforePopen; actual monotonic elapsed spans launch/reap/persistence; deadline/unlaunched/failed kept; no automatic retries, narrowed population or extra passes.

prospectiveControlGates.whole75AndH27AndD48: Every SAME-ROUND A/B four-pass API-wall sum ratio must lie within reciprocal1.02 in BOTH cache policies for BOTH engines, not only the median across rounds.
prospectiveControlGates.everyInput: Median of3same-round A/B ratios of four-call arithmetic-mean wall windows must lie within reciprocal1.05; all75 inputs BOTH engines/policies. Retain every perround and raw call.
prospectiveControlGates.sixCyclicTails: Additionally each of3same-round per-input A/B ratios within reciprocal1.05; no subset of tails.
prospectiveControlGates.historyDiagnostic: Every A/B worker reports timed-pass1..4 sums and warmup1..2 sums, so drift is visible. No post-hoc pass deletion or normalization.
prospectiveControlGates.ifQualified: Only after sealing this assessment may root predeclare a NEW future candidate experiment using the qualified fixed protocol and unchanged source-specific product targets. Calibration is neither candidate data nor a C2-T retry.
prospectiveControlGates.ifFailed: Retain failure and do not launch candidate cost. Separate diagnosis may be proposed prospectively; no adaptive repetition or immediate better-run selection.

limitations: Longer fixed windows and declared warmup are a hypothesis about repeatability, not a proven correction or attribution to JIT/GC.
A/A qualification establishes precision on this setup/population/time only, not universal accuracy.
Recorded processCPU may exceed wall because its boundary/scope includes process threads; CPU cannot replace wall or normalize candidate figures.
Four-pass cache history is explicitly a new protocol; NORMAL remains configured-cache workload, never an all-hit assertion.
